result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape` in the CLI. The module compiles offline, but I did not run the command, because running the built classes needed a permission approval I didn't force.

**What changed**
- `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/Commands.java`:
  - Added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` and a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`.
  - Added an `analyzeLandscape` entry to `usageInfo()`, so the no-argument overview lists it. It uses the same landscape options.
- `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/CommandLineInterface.java`:
  - `run` dispatches `analyzeLandscape` to the same method as `updateLandscape`.
  - `updateLandscape` now takes the command name and description as parameters, so `-help` prints the name the user typed. `updateLandscape -help` prints the same usage as before.

**Not done**
- The README has no command descriptions at all; it is 29 lines covering build and Docker only. I left it unchanged rather than inventing a command section. If you want the landscape commands documented there, tell me where to put them.
- No tests were run. The `cli` module has no test sources, and I did not exercise `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` or `-help` at runtime.
